subject: Re: Next steps — Evaluation kickoff and trial plan
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps — Evaluation kickoff and trial plan

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for taking the time today — really appreciated the deep dive into Acme's ingestion and moderation workload. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get an eval kicking: 

1) Goal/success criteria: confirm that we can meet 95th%-tile latency <= 300ms for 1-2k rps mixed chat/generation workloads and reduce per-token cost by at least 30% vs your current infra during the eval.

2) Evaluation kickoff: proposed 60-min kickoff with engineering + security to align on trial plan, test data, and access. Topics: trial timeline (3 weeks), success criteria, prompt set/evals, observability hooks (tracing and logs).

3) Who should attend: your platform engineer (Alex), a backend lead, and product owner. From our side: me (AE), Marissa (Solutions Engineer), and Rishi (Sales Manager) for contractual/SLAs.

4) Materials I’ll share before the kickoff: evaluation plan PDF, brief install/access instructions for a private trial, and a sample prompt set template.

Can you share 2-3 time slots this week or next? I have open windows Wed 10:00-12:00 PT and Thu 14:00-16:00 PT; happy to book via this link: https://cal.com/connor_acme/30

Attaching a draft eval plan for reference — we can iterate based on what you want to prioritize.

Best,
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0182

Attachment: acme-eval-plan.pdf (application/pdf, 145 KB)

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme-corp.com>

Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800

Thanks Connor — good summary and excited to move forward. A few quick notes from my side:

- Confirming the 95th%-tile latency target is the right metric for us to validate. We also care about tail latencies under cold-start/high-concurrency.
- Security: we’ll need an initial checklist (SOC2 controls, egress rules, KMS integration) for our security team to review before any private deployment.

Availability:
- Thursday Nov 4: 11:00-12:00 PT good for me.
- Friday Nov 5: 09:00-10:00 PT also possible.

I’ll invite James (platform engineer) and Priya (product owner) once we lock a slot. For the kickoff, can Marissa cover the runtime/observability architecture and provide the sample prompt set?

Thanks,
Alex
Head of AI Platforms | Acme Corp
alex.johnson@acme-corp.com
